text:
maria: Hey team — pinging security for a quick privacy/auth review on my PR. Changing how we mount onprem service account creds and adding a narrow KMS key path for model-serving. Would like to merge in tomorrow's 09:00 UTC window if no blockers. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/inference/pulls/4821 :wave:

sanjay: thanks for the ping. can you call out which secrets are new vs. moved? also does this touch any cross-region VPC peering or egress ACLs?

maria: short summary:
- new: kms_key_id for onprem HSM bridge (scoped to project-redwood-inference)
- moved: SERVICE_TOKEN -> moved from env to projected k8s secret (token now read-only, no wide RBAC)
- no new peering changes, just an allow rule for 10.4.0.0/16 -> customer onprem subnet for the k8s node pool

jump-to snippet:
```yaml
env: 
  - name: SERVICE_TOKEN
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: inference-service-token
        key: token
```

sec-bot: automated-scan: secret-scanner v2 ran on PR#4821 — result: 1 informational finding (SERVICE_TOKEN moved to secret, OK). No high severity leaks. See pipeline artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4821/artifacts

jonathan: quick ops Q — onprem deploys: how will this behave in an air-gapped environment? the allow rule to customer subnet sounds like it might fail in fully offline setups. do you have a graceful fallback (eg local KMS stub) documented?

maria: good call. behavior: if KMS handshake fails we fallback to local sealed key store in the pod (same codepath as previous onprem package). I added a config flag `ENABLE_HSM_BRIDGE=true|false` and updated the docs in the repo (docs/onprem/hsm.md). I also added a smoke test to the E2E job that runs with ENABLE_HSM_BRIDGE=false to simulate air-gapped.

alex: I skimmed the PR — code looks good. two tiny asks before I can lgtm:
1) add a note in CHANGELOG about the token projection change (ops needs to know)
2) tighten the network allow to specific node CIDRs rather than the whole /16 if possible

maria: will do both today. CHANGELOG entry + narrow rule to node CIDRs (we already have them in infra repo, will reference). Thank you! :pray:

sanjay: also, please add a short threat-model blurb in the PR description: attack surface for SERVICE_TOKEN after projection, and why KMS scope is limited. that's the only thing blocking my approval.

maria: added the threat-model section and KMS scope screenshot. PTAL.

sec-bot: policy-check: iam-policy-linter passed. no admin-level bindings detected.

alex: CI is green on my side. once sanjay gives an ok I'll mark lgtm and we can merge in the 09:00 UTC slot. :thumbsup:

sanjay: reviewed the threat-model blurb — looks reasonable, key is scoped and token projection reduces exposure. i have one nit about the audit log retention comment, but that's not a blocker for merge. Approving now. :white_check_mark:
maria: amazing, thanks everyone. merging after the 09:00 window if no rollbacks. will post a short deploy note in #eng-oncall when done.

jonathan: thanks — please also ping devex to update the private deployment quickstart (brief note about ENABLE_HSM_BRIDGE).

maria: will do. closing loop.
